theseus.name: Swarm of Theseus
theseus.question: Can a fresh successor recover supported task state across a real memory boundary?
theseus.contrast: Structured versus prose handoff from the same eligible archive; recent history and BM25 are mandatory practical baselines.
theseus.metric: Critical task-state recovery, stale commitments, citations and total writer plus decision cost.
theseus.reason: Natural handoffs address the gap between Boolean instruction following and preserving useful acquired task state. A1 transport failure supplies no learning result.
theseus.limit: This tests handoff recovery, not emergent culture or exact historical agent reconstruction.

dissenter.name: Right Dissenter
dissenter.question: Does fresh sufficient evidence reopen a previously stopped decision in full historical context?
dissenter.contrast: Source-only versus full history; separate history, peer stance and clock overlays only in a new controlled design.
dissenter.metric: Evidence-justified reopening, unsafe resumption and unnecessary deferral.
dissenter.reason: RD5 lost four late resumptions despite decisive evidence. Real correction records may supply semantic variation beyond the finite interval parser.
dissenter.limit: Do not score the eventual historical winner as correct or infer that a fixed reserve now works.

quorum.name: Quorum of Mirrors
quorum.question: Does a retold claim preserve entity, quantity, time, negation, uncertainty and attribution?
quorum.contrast: Same source binding in every arm; literal/structured parser and BM25 baselines versus semantic extraction.
quorum.metric: Claim fidelity and unsupported evidence admission, separately from source-origin resolution.
quorum.reason: Authenticated graph traversal already solves the revised provenance task. The remaining candidate need is faithful semantic extraction, not guessing ancestry from similarity.
quorum.limit: A citation is not entailment; different speakers are not independent evidence. Reviewed lineage does not certify statistical independence.

healing.name: Healing Helping Hands
healing.question: Can selective stronger-model referral repair evidence-reading errors on natural reports?
healing.contrast: Always-cheap, always-strong, selective referral and equal-count random referral; count both cheap passes.
healing.metric: Accepted-wrong rate, correction and false correction, referral count and end-to-end cost.
controls: correct cheap answer harmed by help
healing.reason: C5 addresses metadata leakage while retaining 12 authored templates. A separate external corpus can test transfer beyond those templates.
healing.limit: Do not replace the approved C5 qualification or main assignments. Two order variants are dependent re-evaluations.

influence.name: How to win agents and influence swarms
influence.question: Does peer advice change decisions beyond private reconsideration under matched evidence?
influence.contrast: Records only, private reconsideration, stance only and evidence-bearing advice; manipulate attribution separately.
influence.metric: Wrong-to-correct repair, correct-to-wrong corruption, deferral and evidence uptake.
influence.reason: Village supplies natural peer statements and possible source access; it can diversify the reused development dossiers after labels and transfer terms are established.
influence.limit: Observed agreement or persuasion is confounded. This does not authorize attacks or establish external influence propagation.

immune.name: Immune Response
immune.question: Does explicit supersession prevent acting on stale remembered state?
immune.contrast: Append-only correction versus explicit supersession with identical underlying observations and simple freshness baseline.
immune.metric: Stale action admissions, unnecessary repair and useful repair separately.
immune.reason: Memory and update records could extend observation-freshness cases. A4 has no valid native responses; a data revision cannot repair transport readiness.
immune.limit: Secondary fit only. Natural mistakes are not adversarial compromise, and logs do not create an action-dependent repair simulator.

phantom.name: Phantom Coast
phantom.question: Can natural reports be normalized into admissible evidence without dropping reliable corrections or counting copied claims twice?
phantom.contrast: Natural prose versus an independently checked structured representation of exactly the same available evidence; frozen parser and graph baselines.
phantom.metric: Evidence-label error, false exclusion of reliable evidence and unsupported admission. Downstream regret only in a separately declared calibrated sandbox.
phantom.reason: PC8 tests prose normalization in four authored families. The corpus offers an external semantic-transfer lane after complete receipt chains are verified.
phantom.limit: Do not replace approved PC8 assignments or pretend historical logs supply calibrated source reliability, counterfactual verification cost or optimal policy.
